hints.title: 2D to 1D Row Compression
hints.text: Compute horizontal prefix sums for each row. By fixing a left column c1 and right column c2, each row compresses into a single scalar value.

hints.title: Subarray Sum Equals K Reduction
hints.text: With columns fixed, the problem reduces to finding 1D vertical subarrays whose cumulative sum equals target, which can be solved in linear time.

hints.title: Running Prefix Accumulator
hints.text: Iterate all pairs 0 <= c1 <= c2 < C. Maintain a frequency lookup of running vertical sums initialized with {0: 1}. For each row, add count of (cur - target) to the total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(R^2 * C^2) submatrices directly takes quartic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixing column pairs and applying 1D prefix hashing runs in O(C^2 * R) time and O(R) extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should reduce 2D submatrix sum to 1D subarray sum using column interval compression.
complexity.notes: If R < C, transposing the matrix achieves O(R^2 * C) time.
